The most important change is that the bank calculates the Total Leverage Ratio at {{fact:cf09aa30-14d6-4214-b8dc-b7369f0a5824}} against a maximum of {{fact:cf5ce94d-59c2-485d-ac3c-f864cf033957}}. The bank's calculation is {{fact:cf09aa30-14d6-4214-b8dc-b7369f0a5824}} against a maximum of {{fact:cf5ce94d-59c2-485d-ac3c-f864cf033957}}, a cushion of {{fact:b1a2482c-4174-437b-956c-da582a08fa26}}. The compliance certificate reports {{fact:4fa0c88a-e65a-40de-8587-da3efbed98a5}} and claims compliance. The facts held do not explain why the bank's calculation and the borrower's certificate differ, and a reviewer should reconcile them. The Current Ratio covenant is compliant at {{fact:0f340d0e-1385-41ee-a0dd-bda8b6003f21}} against a minimum of {{fact:13194732-46fe-4a3a-afd0-41790b749b4f}}. Its cushion is {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}}, and the certificate figure of {{fact:16c781a3-caaf-47e8-b626-8a029b991ff4}} agrees with the bank's calculation."},{"section":"risks","body":"The highest-priority item is the critical work item: the Total Leverage Ratio fails on the bank's calculation while the certificate reports compliance. It has been decided for escalation to committee. A medium-severity signal confirms the leverage covenant is already breached, with a cushion of {{fact:b1a2482c-4174-437b-956c-da582a08fa26}}. A second medium-severity signal flags thin Current Ratio headroom of {{fact:9e590747-9307-45f2-be07-cc4a806e601c}}. A low-severity signal indicates that Current Ratio headroom has declined across the March, June and September measurements. The interim quarterly values are not among the facts provided, so a reviewer should confirm that trend directly."}]}
